text:
Beyond sin,
indescribable, I adore you,
and when I search for words
I find only kisses.

On your chest, your nape,
I love you.
In the secret chalice,
I love you.

where your belly curves,
your back flees,
your body is fragrant—
I love you.

translation.title: Beyond Sin...
